title: Chain-Link Systems
coreMove: Find the indispensable weak link that caps the whole system and repair it systemically.
sourcePressure: Some systems are governed by their weakest indispensable link, so strengthening a strong link cannot compensate for a broken necessary one. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Improve the average performance of the system and the weak part will matter less.
